national_news.title: PM Modi Announces ₹14,000 Crore Projects in Gujarat and Releases 24th PM-KISAN Instalment
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi initiated developmental projects worth over ₹14,000 crore in Banaskantha and Ekta Nagar, Gujarat, including foundation laying for Ahmedabad Metro Phase-2A and Phase-2B.
Released the 24th instalment under the PM-KISAN scheme, transferring ₹19,000 crore directly to eligible farmers across India.
Inaugurated the Embryo Transfer Technology-IVF Lab and the Bharat Bovine Breeding and Research Centre to enhance genetic upgradation of cattle by 10 to 20 times.

national_news.title: Sports and Education Ministries Sign MoU with UNESCO for Clean Sport Classroom Toolkit
bullets: The Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports and the Ministry of Education exchanged an MoU with UNESCO to introduce the 'Sports Values in Every Classroom Toolkit' across Indian schools.
The initiative integrates values such as fairness, respect, discipline, and integrity into everyday education and grassroots sports.
Video modules under the toolkit will be translated and distributed in 13 Indian languages to maximize reach and promote sporting ethics.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Major Industrial Schemes, PMVGSY, and 3% DA Hike
bullets: Approved the Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme with a ₹10,000 crore outlay for 13 years (up to FY 2039-40) to build a domestic shipping container manufacturing ecosystem.
Launched the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana (PMVGSY) as a Centrally Sponsored Scheme with ₹7,395 crore outlay (2026-27 to 2030-31) covering 2.78 lakh Rural Local Bodies.

Sanctioned the Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme (₹1,856 crore outlay over 8 years) to develop Sports Goods Manufacturing Zones (SGMZs) and approved a 3% Dearness Allowance/Relief hike for 48 lakh central employees and 68 lakh pensioners.

national_news.title: Department of Pharmaceuticals Achieves Major Milestones Under Special Campaign 6.0
bullets: The Department of Pharmaceuticals under the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilisers participated in the Special Campaign for Disposal of Pending Matters (SCDPM) 6.0 from October 2 to 31.

The department conducted 14,700 cleanliness drives, reviewed 4,283 physical files (weeding out 489), and freed up 2,200 square feet of office space across NPPA, NIPERs, PMBI, and public sector undertakings.
Settled 132 public grievances and 39 appeals registered on CPGRAMS, generating ₹2,30,187 from scrap disposal and processing 1,011 obsolete electronic items under E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves 3% Increase in Dearness Allowance and Dearness Relief
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved a 3-percentage-point hike in Dearness Allowance (DA) for central government employees and Dearness Relief (DR) for pensioners, raising the rate from 60% to 63% of basic pay/pension.
Effective retroactively from July 1, 2026, the revision benefits around 48.54 lakh central government employees and 68.71 lakh pensioners.
Calculated as per the accepted formula under the 7th Central Pay Commission to cushion inflation, the revision carries an annual exchequer impact of ₹10,016.10 crore.

national_news.title: NSIC Presents ₹47.76 Crore Dividend to Union MSME Minister for FY 2025–26
bullets: Dr. Subhransu Sekhar Acharya, CMD of National Small Industries Corporation Limited (NSIC), presented a dividend of ₹47.76 crore to Union MSME Minister Jitan Ram Manjhi.
NSIC, a Schedule 'A' Mini Ratna PSU under the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, recorded a total revenue of ₹3,767 crore and a Profit After Tax (PAT) of ₹159 crore.
The corporation plays a key institutional role in enterprise creation, skill development, and fostering growth across micro and small enterprises in India.

national_news.title: Ayush Ministry Launches National Innovation Challenge on AI in Ayurveda
bullets: The All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA), under the Ministry of Ayush, collaborated with IIT Bombay's TechFest to launch the National Innovation Challenge for AI applications in Ayurveda.
The challenge leverages IIT Bombay's open-source Ayurveda Large Language Model, 'AyurParam', to address challenges in clinical practice, research, classical text retrieval, and treatment planning.

Key announcements included the establishment of 'AI in Ay – Secretariat for Artificial Intelligence in Ayurveda' with the World Ayurveda Foundation, an IPR facility for Ayurveda, and an MoU with Reliance Retail.

national_news.title: Health Ministry Reviews Swachhata Initiatives and Facilities under Special Campaign 6 at AIIMS
bullets: Union Health Minister JP Nadda reviewed cleanliness, sanitation, and sustainability practices undertaken at AIIMS New Delhi as part of Special Campaign 6.
Inspected the newly built 2,970 sq. meter Patient Waiting Lounge at AIIMS Trauma Centre Extension Campus, constructed by Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) under CSR to serve as an Aashray Shelter.

AIIMS highlighted key sustainability metrics, including reusing 19.6 lakh litres of treated wastewater daily for horticulture and reducing electricity consumption by 10.5% through energy conservation measures.

national_news.title: INS Trishul Concludes Operational Deployment Port Call at Civitavecchia, Italy
bullets: Indian Naval Ship (INS) Trishul concluded its port call at Civitavecchia, Italy, as part of its ongoing operational deployment in the Mediterranean Sea.
The ship's crew engaged in professional interactions, cross-deck visits to the Italian Navy aircraft carrier ITS Cavour, and bilateral exchanges with the Italian Navy and Coast Guard.
The deployment aimed to strengthen bilateral maritime cooperation, interoperability, and strategic ties between India and Italy.

national_news.title: UNICEF and PIB Organise Media Workshop on Inclusive Early Childhood Development
bullets: PIB Thiruvananthapuram and UNICEF jointly organised a media workshop focused on Inclusive Early Childhood Development (iECD) in Kerala.
The initiative urged stronger government support to reduce financial burdens on families with disabled children and emphasised early identification of developmental delays.
Sessions covered leveraging AI for effective reporting on disability issues and building inclusive healthcare and health systems.

national_news.title: 19th Ganga Flood Control Board Meeting Chaired by Jal Shakti Minister
bullets: Union Minister of Jal Shakti C.R. Patil chaired the 19th Meeting of the Ganga Flood Control Board (GFCB) at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.
Launched the 'Punah Bharan Mobile App', developed by BISAG-N in collaboration with the National Water Mission, for scientific identification of groundwater recharge sites.
Reviewed the restructuring of the Ganga Flood Control Commission (GFCC) and master planning for flood and erosion management in the Ganga Basin, which was originally established on April 18, 1972.

national_news.title: 14th International Tourism Mart Inaugurated in Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh
bullets: The 14th edition of the International Tourism Mart (ITM) was organized in Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh, by the Ministry of Tourism in collaboration with North Eastern States.
Union Minister for Tourism and Culture Gajendra Singh Shekhawat inaugurated the three-day event aimed at showcasing the tourism potential of the eight North Eastern States.
The initiative focuses on driving adventure, eco, and experiential tourism while enhancing regional connectivity and skill development for youth.

national_news.title: World Stroke Day Observed with Campaign 'Every Minute Counts'
bullets: World Stroke Day observed with the campaign message 'Every Minute Counts – Know the Signs of Stroke' to highlight the importance of early detection.
Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda urged citizens to recognize key warning signs including sudden facial drooping, arm weakness, and speaking difficulty.
According to AIIMS New Delhi, approximately 18 lakh stroke cases are recorded across India each year, with high blood pressure identified as a leading risk factor.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chairs 54th PRAGATI meeting
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired the 54th meeting of PRAGATI (Pro-Active Governance and Timely Implementation) at Seva Teerth in New Delhi.
Reviewed infrastructure projects across Railways, Ekta Malls, and Drug Parks worth over ₹16,000 crore covering 31 States and Union Territories.
Highlighted that nearly 25 crore people have moved out of multidimensional poverty through sustained governance efforts and welfare schemes.

national_news.title: Central Bureau of Communication Organizes Vigilance Awareness Workshop
bullets: The Central Bureau of Communication (CBC) and Press Information Bureau (PIB) organized a one-day workshop on vigilance awareness under the theme "Probity for Prosperity" in Jammu.
The workshop focused on promoting integrity, transparency, accountability, and ethical conduct in public administration.
Discussions highlighted the Public Interest Disclosure and Protection of Informers (PIDPI) Resolution, outlining mechanisms for reporting corruption while protecting the identity of informants.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Clears Rs 2,014-Crore Drinking Water Project for 3 Towns
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced a Rs 2,014 crore drinking water project targeting Aurangabad, Sasaram, and Dehri.
NABARD approved Rs 1,774 crore in financing for the scheme under the Rural Infrastructure Development Fund (RIDF).
The project will utilize surface water from the Sone River, catering initially to 8 lakh people and expanding to nearly 12 lakh residents by 2051 under the Jal-Jeevan-Hariyali campaign.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Approves AI Policy 2026 to Boost Technology and Startups
bullets: The Bihar Cabinet chaired by Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary approved the Bihar Artificial Intelligence Policy 2026 on October 28, 2026.
The policy offers capital investment subsidies, cloud infrastructure usage incentives, SGST reimbursement, and power tariff subsidies to AI companies and GCCs.
The state government aims to train 500,000 young people in AI over five years and has partnered with IIT Patna and tech giants like Google and Microsoft.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Completes Aadhaar Seeding for 95.12% of Social Security Pensioners
bullets: Bihar successfully completed Aadhaar seeding for 1.03 crore social security pension beneficiaries, achieving a coverage of 95.12%.
The Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Pension Yojana recorded the highest number of Aadhaar-seeded beneficiaries at over 54.17 lakh.
Madhubani district recorded the highest number of beneficiaries with completed Aadhaar seeding in the state.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Museum Ranks 9th Globally in Worth a Journey's 2026 List
bullets: Patna's Bihar Museum secured the 9th rank in Worth a Journey's 2026 list of the world's 100 best museums, outranking New York's The Met and Paris's Louvre.
It is the highest-ranked museum in Asia and the only Indian institution featured in the top 100 of this list.
Established in 2015 and spread over 13 acres, the museum was designed by renowned Japanese architect Fumihiko Maki.

bihar_news.title: ICAR-CIFE Kolkata Organises Internship on Diversified Aquaculture for Bihar Students
bullets: ICAR-Central Institute of Fisheries Education (CIFE), Kolkata Centre, conducted a 14-day internship for 16 B.F.Sc. students from RDS College, Muzaffarpur, Bihar.
The training covered modern aquaculture technologies including biofloc systems, RAS, aquaponics, and pearl farming.
Field visits included Nalban sewage-fed aquaculture facilities and ornamental fish breeding units in Howrah.

bihar_news.title: Patna Becomes Bihar's First Municipality to Issue Municipal Bonds
bullets: Patna is preparing to borrow Rs 200 crore via municipal bonds, becoming Bihar's first-ever municipal bond issuer and the first in India for the fiscal year.
The 10-year borrowing aims to fund crucial infrastructural renewal such as sewage treatment, drainage, and water supply.
World Bank assessments highlight that India needs $840 billion in urban infrastructure investment from 2021 to 2036.

bihar_news.title: Delhi Government Sends Proposal for Direct AC Luxury Buses to Bihar
bullets: The Delhi Transport Department sent a proposal to Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu for final approval to launch direct inter-state bus services to Bihar.
The project aims to deploy over 50 air-conditioned luxury buses connecting Delhi with seven locations in Bihar, targeting a launch before the Chhath festival.
The MoU for the project has already been approved by both the Delhi and Bihar governments to ease travel congestion during festive seasons.

bihar_news.title: Delhi-Bihar AC Luxury Bus Service Planned Ahead of Chhath Festival
bullets: Delhi Transport Department planned a fleet of over 50 AC luxury buses under a wet-lease arrangement with private operators to connect Delhi with seven Bihar destinations.
Cities under consideration for the service include Patna, Gaya, Muzaffarpur, Darbhanga, Purnia, and Bhagalpur.
The initiative aims to provide an alternative travel option for migrant workers and families travelling during the heavy rush of Chhath Puja.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Combined Entrance Examination Board Postpones MBBS/BDS Stray Round Allotment
bullets: The Bihar Combined Entrance Examination Board (BCECEB) postponed the stray round seat allotment result for NEET MBBS and BDS admissions 2026.
The stray round serves as the final opportunity for eligible candidates to secure vacant medical and dental college seats in the state based on merit rank.
Candidates were advised to monitor the official BCECEB portal for the revised schedule and keep their documents ready for reporting.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Announces Plans for Signature Roads Across All Cities to Support Urbanization
bullets: Bihar Urban Development and Housing Minister Nitish Mishra announced plans to develop signature roads across all cities to manage faster urbanization.
Currently, approximately 11% of Bihar's population lives in urban areas compared to the national average of 33%.
The infrastructure push includes planned satellite townships, improved connectivity, and the integration of modern technology and project monitoring in public works.
